svg.text: SYSTEM BOUNDARY — rename this. Everything inside is what you are designing.
1. Rename every block after its RESPONSIBILITY, not a part you plan to buy.
2. Replace every [ ... ] label with what actually travels, its rate and units.
3. Delete blocks you do not need. Add the ones you do.
4. Check that nothing draws power with no supply path drawn.
5. Delete this note and the legend stays.
